lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਤਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach bin bhavajal jaai na tariaa ||
lines.translation: Without the Truth, the terrifying world-ocean cannot be crossed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਸਮੁੰਦੁ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਭਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ehu samu(n)d athaahu mahaa bikh bhariaa ||
lines.translation: This ocean is vast and unfathomable; it is overflowing with the worst poison.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਹੈ ਅਤੀਤੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਲੇ ਊਪਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: rahai ateet guramat le oopar har nirabhau kai ghar paaiaa ||6||
lines.translation: One who receives the Guru's Teachings, and remains aloof and detached, obtains a place in the home of the Fearless Lord. ||6||
False is the cleverness of loving attachment to the world.
In no time at all, it comes and goes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ਉਪਜੈ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਖਪਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: naam visaar chalahi abhimaanee upajai binas khapaaiaa ||7||
lines.translation: Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the proud egotistical people depart; in creation and destruction they are wasted away. ||7||
In creation and destruction, they are bound in bondage.
The noose of egotism and Maya is around their necks.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸੋ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਬੰਧਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: jis raam naam naahee mat guramat so jam pur ba(n)dh chalaaiaa ||8||
lines.translation: Whoever does not accept the Guru's Teachings, and does not dwell upon the Lord's Name, is bound and bagged, and dragged into the City of Death. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੋਖ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur bin mokh mukat kiu paaeeai ||
lines.translation: Without the Guru, how can anyone be emancipated or liberated?

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਿਉ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin gur raam naam kiu dhiaaeeai ||
lines.translation: Without the Guru, how can anyone meditate on the Lord's Name?

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਤਰਹੁ ਭਵ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਏ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: guramat lehu tarahu bhav dutar mukat bhae sukh paaiaa ||9||
lines.translation: Accepting the Guru's Teachings, cross over the arduous, terrifying world-ocean; you shall be emancipated, and find peace. ||9||
Through the Guru's Teachings, Krishna lifted up the mountain of Govardhan.
Through the Guru's Teachings, Rama floated stones across the ocean.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: guramat lehu param pad paaeeai naanak gur bharam chukaaiaa ||10||
lines.translation: Accepting the Guru's Teachings, the supreme status is obtained; O Nanak, the Guru eradicates doubt. ||10||
Accepting the Guru's Teachings, cross over to the other side through Truth.
O soul, remember the Lord within your heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਕੇ ਫਾਹੇ ਕਾਟਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਅਕੁਲ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: jam ke phaahe kaatahi har jap akul nira(n)jan paaiaa ||11||
lines.translation: The noose of death is cut away, meditating on the Lord; you shall obtain the Immaculate Lord, who has no ancestry. ||11||
Through the Guru's Teachings, the Holy become one's friends and Siblings of Destiny.
Through the Guru's Teachings, the inner fire is subdued and extinguished.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: man mukh naam japahu jagajeevan rid a(n)tar alakh lakhaaiaa ||12||
lines.translation: Chant the Naam with your mind and mouth; know the unknowable Lord, the Life of the World, deep within the nucleus of your heart. ||12||
The Gurmukh understands, and is pleased with the Word of the Shabad.
Who does he praise or slander?

lines.gurmukhi: ਚੀਨਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਜਗਦੀਸਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਗੰਨਾਥੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: cheenahu aap japahu jagadeesar har jaga(n)naath man bhaaiaa ||13||
lines.translation: Know yourself, and meditate on the Lord of the Universe; let your mind be pleased with the Lord, the Master of the Universe. ||13||
Know the One who pervades all the realms of the universe.
As Gurmukh, understand and realize the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਭੋਗੇ ਭੋਗਣਹਾਰਾ ਰਹੈ ਅਤੀਤੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: ghat ghat bhoge bhoganahaaraa rahai ateet sabaaiaa ||14||
lines.translation: The Enjoyer enjoys each and every heart, and yet He remains detached from all. ||14||
Through the Guru's Teachings, chant the Pure Praises of the Lord.
Through the Guru's Teachings, behold the lofty Lord with your eyes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰੰਗਾਇਆ ॥੧੫॥੩॥੨੦॥
lines.transliteration: sravanee naam sunai har baanee naanak har ra(n)g ra(n)gaaiaa ||15||3||20||
lines.translation: Whoever listens to the Lord's Name, and the Word of His Bani, O Nanak, is imbued with the color of the Lord's Love. ||15||3||20||
Maaroo, First Mehl:
Leave behind sexual desire, anger and the slander of others.
Renounce greed and possessiveness, and become carefree.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕਾ ਸੰਗਲੁ ਤੋੜਿ ਨਿਰਾਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bhram kaa sa(n)gal toR niraalaa har a(n)tar har ras paaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: Break the chains of doubt, and remain unattached; you shall find the Lord, and the Lord's sublime essence, deep within yourself. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਸਿ ਦਾਮਨਿ ਜਿਉ ਚਮਕਿ ਚੰਦਾਇਣੁ ਦੇਖੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: nis daaman jiu chamak cha(n)daain dekhai ||
lines.translation: As one sees the flash of lightning in the night,
see the Divine Light deep within your nucleus, day and night.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਨੰਦ ਰੂਪੁ ਅਨੂਪੁ ਸਰੂਪਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਦੇਖਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: aana(n)d roop anoop saroopaa gur poorai dekhaaiaa ||2||
lines.translation: The Lord, the embodiment of bliss, incomparably beautiful, reveals the Perfect Guru. ||2||
So meet with the True Guru, and God Himself will save you.
He placed the lamps of the sun and the moon in the home of the sky.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਿ ਅਦਿਸਟੁ ਰਹਹੁ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਸਭੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: dekh adisat rahahu liv laagee sabh tribhavan braham sabaaiaa ||3||
lines.translation: See the invisible Lord, and remain absorbed in loving devotion. God is all throughout the three worlds. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਏ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭਉ ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit ras paae trisanaa bhau jaae ||
lines.translation: Obtaining the sublime ambrosial essence, desire and fear are dispelled.
The state of inspired illumination is obtained, and self-conceit is eradicated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਊਚੀ ਪਦਵੀ ਊਚੋ ਊਚਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: oochee padavee oocho oochaa niramal sabad kamaaiaa ||4||
lines.translation: The lofty and exalted state, the highest of the high is obtained, practicing the immaculate Word of the Shabad. ||4||
The Naam, the Name of the invisible and unfathomable Lord, is infinite.
